en.HOW_TO_PLAY:
1. Camp: drag items from the shop into your pack. Drag to the shop to sell, to storage to store, and tap a placed item again to rotate it.
2. Touching items buff each other (✨). Two copies of the same item that touch EVOLVE while you rest. Recipe pairs that touch FUSE into something new.
3. After the floor B5 boss you choose one of your class's three paths. Its relic is one piece of that path's Masterwork: place it touching the class's two top items to forge it while you rest. Only one Masterwork per run.
4. Pick a door, then fight: your pack fights on its own. Every item charges up and fires; triggers fill your Ultimate.
5. HP carries over between floors. Hearts are extra lives. Reach floor B15 and beat the final boss.
